intro: Your dining space just found its statement piece. The Leo table brings classic charm with a fresh twist—ideal for family feasts or everyday elegance.

features.title: Classic with a twist
features.text: A timeless silhouette paired with modern touches makes this table effortlessly stylish for any setting.

features.title: Strength in every frame
features.text: Made with a sturdy rubber wood frame, your table stands strong through years of shared meals and stories.

features.title: Glass accents that shine
features.text: Two glass inserts break up the solid form with lightness and sophistication—simple, yet striking.

features.title: Worry-free finish
features.text: The stain-resistant surface keeps your table looking clean and polished, no matter the mess.

features.title: Room to gather
features.text: Its spacious layout offers plenty of room for all your guests, dishes, and conversations to unfold.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
